label: Comparative-degree calibrations and superlative uses
summary:
078d4c69-9d31-56f0-8ddf-a3306f0d7a33 (Variant): 963f8e06 uses identification of the supplied Maxime extension with mere weak maximality, along with a separate greatest-degree calibration. It uses the implication from weak maximum to Maxime and the implication from Maxime to greatest degree; the relevant inclusions would suffice for its direction without a full maximal biconditional. Retain the conditional calibration.

0e3d0877-0ac0-5df8-9ec6-ca5b7659a506 (Variant): c0be361f uses distinct-candidate strict comparability in esse to move from a weak maximum to MAXIME_3. Comparable weak degrees allowing ties are insufficient for strict greatness; the converse route uses asymmetry. The order premise could be restricted to comparisons with the selected maximum for a local application. Retain the strict-comparison branch.

54cc2502-0b6c-5ea1-b186-50d766c5222a (Variant): 9846490f excludes strict-supremacy calibration at the same frame to select the greatest-degree calibration by exhaustion. A selected witness to a mismatch suffices to establish this negation; mismatch in another model does not. Retain as a local elimination input.

675b22e7-a29e-579a-8626-ffaefdbfae7b (Variant): 9846490f assumes one of three calibrations in the same profile. MaximumDefinitionFork.remainder makes all three fail on a supplied extension, so the theorem's finite menu has independent coverage content. Direct greatest calibration bypasses the menu, leaving the exclusions unnecessary on that route. Retain the named-menu branch.

aee5daab-cb7a-54ff-b6ca-82dbcd061794 (Variant): 9846490f excludes mere maximality in the same frame. This is distinct from excluding strict supremacy, and local mismatch suffices. Direct greatest calibration bypasses both exclusions. Retain as a local elimination input.
